notes.title: Woodsy Studio Releases Crimson Spires, a Horror-themed Otome Title on Steam
notes.notes:
[i][b]Crimson Spires [/b][/i]is here! Investigate the mysteries of Bataille, Missouri with one of four romantic partners. Play as Erika Wright, a former FBI agent stranded in a small town cut off from the rest of the world by dangerous obsidian towers that threaten the life of anyone who dares cross their threshold. However... With the right help, you might just find some happiness in this strange prison. 

Will you choose Julian Bataille, the dark and brooding heir to his family's lead empire? Or his brother Liam, the happy-go-lucky adopted sibling who just wants to find a place in the world. Beware... They're both vampires.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31856198/08aa365ae419d4e9ec46b572cd5c14228a7d5ff9.jpg[/img]

If you'd rather a human companion, choose Maddy, the headstrong lifetime resident of Bataille, who has faced prejudice and judgement from her peers even before the town was closed off from the rest of the world. Or perhaps August. An escaped convict, he is at your mercy in Bataille... unless you decide to be at his. 

Check out [u][b] Crimson Spires[/b][/u] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292520/Crimson_Spires/]HERE[/url] on Steam.

notes.title: Michael/Lucifer CG on our Patreon
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We just launched our [url=https://www.patreon.com/woodsy_studio]Patreon[/url], and the first custom content available is a CG of Michael and Lucifer tango dancing ~ 

[url=https://www.patreon.com/woodsy_studio][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31856198/3c7f74cfee995630738a741102f6258497fb3215.jpg[/img][/url]

Funds from Patreon will help us develop our next game, Crimson Spires, a blend of otome romance and horror (hint: there be vampires). Meanwhile, patrons will see art, screenshots, and game development posts before we post them anywhere else. 

[url=https://www.patreon.com/woodsy_studio][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31856198/bc33062a542a277f7735ba9f6d21db0d6f12a29c.jpg[/img][/url]

One way or another, thanks for playing our games and we hope you continue to enjoy our work. Your support encourages and enables us to keep creating!

<3 Jenny and Malcolm

notes.title: Do you have a CG request?
notes.notes:
Hello friends! 

Malcolm and I (Jenny) plan to launch a Patreon soon for our ongoing game development efforts. For the most part, the Patreon will provide access to behind-the-scenes game development. It will also allow patrons to see a lot of content for our next game before that content becomes public. But our top-tier reward will likely be custom content made for general demand, such as supplemental artwork or a side story. So...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31856198/3f57c44c225633383701b205f28b5cd2fe8e749e.jpg[/img]

I plan to start off the Patreon launch with a custom CG made for miraclr - Divine Dating Sim. So what would you like to see? It could be a romantic pairing between specific angels, with the MC, or maybe just a fun pinup of one of the angels alone? I don't plan any nudity, but I'm happy to dive into NSFW material. So tell me what you'd like to see, and I'll see what I can do! 

<3

notes.title: New game released!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone! We wanted to let you know about our latest game, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/858830/Echoes_of_the_Fey_The_Last_Sacrament/]Echoes of the Fey: The Last Sacrament[/url][/b], which released today!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/858830/Echoes_of_the_Fey_The_Last_Sacrament/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31856198/a5396db9a408e4b295acd8dcf70f79d0a37aef44.jpg[/img][/url]

Echoes of the Fey is an ongoing series mixing high fantasy and pulp detective mystery. Each episode contains a narrative-heavy adventure game with branching story-lines and a standalone plot of adventure and romance. In The Last Sacrament, Sofya’s loyalty grows divided when she is hired for one job and blackmailed into another.

This is our first full game developed with Unreal Engine 4. We've used the power of the UE4 engine to add 3D camera views and other cinematic effects to the traditional visual novel elements. There's also a mini-game called RiftRealms in which you can play an in-world tabletop RPG with other characters. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/858830/Echoes_of_the_Fey_The_Last_Sacrament/]Get it here![/url]

The soundtrack is also available as DLC, and both of them will be 10% off the first week of release. We sincerely hope you enjoy this game, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts!

-- Jenny and Malcolm

notes.title: Update with Super Skip!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Based on some feedback, we thought it would be useful to add a "Super Skip" mode to help you replay days you've already seen. Currently, the "Super Skip" option will show up in the "Preferences" menu if you already possess a save file for the *next* day. 

Please note that as the name implies, "Super Skip" mode is very powerful and will speed through content almost instantly. It will pause only for "Reply" opportunities or manual "Skip" selections. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31856198/671ead217c9515b85cee07e1677919fd7af93c02.jpg[/img]

It should also be noted that once you exit "Super Skip" mode, you may need to allow some scenes a minute or two to catch up to real time.
